description: Call-to-Action best practices for conversion optimization

rules.rule: Every page must have at least 1 CTA
rules.reasoning: A page with no CTA fails its primary conversion goal. Visitors have no clear next step.

rules.rule: Recommended 1 CTA per 300 words of content
rules.reasoning: Too few CTAs miss conversion opportunities. Too many CTAs create decision fatigue and hurt conversions.

rules.rule: Landing pages should have 1-3 focused CTAs maximum
rules.reasoning: More than 3 competing CTAs creates the paradox of choice — users convert less when given too many options.
